name: Circular Bowl with Lightly Flaring Lip and Decoration of Two Pink Dragons against a Yellow Ground, Each Dragon Pursuing a Flaming Jewel
dimensions: H. 7.6 x Diam. 21 cm (3 x 8 1/4 in.)
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；late 18th-early 19th century；Enameled porcelain: porcelain with decoration painted in overglaze yellow, pink, and red enamels and scrolling floral pattern lightly incised in the yellow enamel; with spurious underglaze cobalt blue mark reading "Da Qing Qianlong nian zhi" in seal-script characters on the base
